component.name: Rclone Browser NG
component.summary: Simple cross-platform GUI for the rclone command line tool

description.p: Rclone Browser NG is a cross-platform Qt6 GUI for rclone, a command line tool to synchronize (and mount) files from remote cloud storage services like Google Drive, OneDrive, Nextcloud, Dropbox, Amazon S3, and many others.

Features include browsing and modifying any rclone remote, running multiple background transfers with per-file progress, mounting remotes as local filesystems, streaming media to external players, drag-and-drop uploads, saved reusable tasks, and a configurable dark mode.
Community continuation of the abandoned kapitainsky/RcloneBrowser fork, restored to work with modern rclone (v1.56+) and Qt 6.

Bug fix release: starting minimized now always shows the tray icon so the application stays reachable, including when launched with the minimized or tray command line flags or with settings written by older builds.

Maintenance release with safer saved-task handling, non-blocking operations, staged-transfer recovery, accessibility coverage, local packaging checks, and mount preset and stale-mount recovery improvements.

First NG release: Qt 6 port, modern rclone parsing, async delete, authenticated mount RC, dark-mode polish, and many reliability fixes. Over 80 features added since the abandoned upstream including saved tasks, scheduling, dual-pane view, file preview, version browser, cross-remote search, and cloud trash support.
Upstream release with proxy configuration, larger remote icon choices, directory trees, default rclone options, and public-link support.
Upstream release with AppImage and Windows packaging, portable mode, dark mode, high-DPI support, and broader terminal compatibility.
